payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Move the source mug to the right of the headphones.
outcome.target: The mug present in the source image, moved so it is positioned to the right of the headphones. A newly introduced or duplicated mug on the right does not fulfill the request unless evidence establishes it is the source mug.
outcome.reference: Use the source and edited images to assess the source mug's identity, correspondence, and position relative to the headphones. Consider all plausible correspondence candidates and visual evidence of change in the source mug's region. Do not assume that a mug appearing on the right is the source mug, or that disappearance, blur, or a new mug alone proves movement.

check.question: Using the support evidence, what does the comparison establish about the source mug's movement toward the right relative to the headphones and its final position? Distinguish supported progress from mere disappearance, blur, or an unrelated mug; if neither progress nor non-progress is supported, remain unresolved.
check.complete_when: Evidence establishes that the source mug itself is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image. Definitive identity is not mandatory if other visual evidence sufficiently supports that the source mug moved there.
check.partial_when: Evidence supports actual progress moving the source mug toward the right relative to the headphones, but does not establish that it is now to their right. Progress may be supported by visual evidence linking a change in the source mug's region to movement even if identity or final position is not fully resolved. Do not count mere disappearance, blur, an unrelated new mug, or a right-side mug without evidence of source-mug progress.
check.absent_when: Evidence supports that the source mug did not move toward the right relative to the headphones. Do not infer absence from disappearance, blur, uncertain correspondence, or an unidentifiable replacement; a separate mug appearing on the right alone does not establish that no movement occurred.
check.unknown_when: After considering the support evidence, it remains genuinely unclear whether the source mug moved toward or to the right of the headphones; use this only when evidence supports neither completion, progress, nor absence.

dependencies.evidence: In the source, the blue mug is left of the headphones. In the edited image, the headphones remain near the center, while two mug-like objects appear: a small white mug just left of them and another white mug to their right. The source mug’s original left-side region is now a conspicuous blurred blue patch, suggesting alteration/removal, but neither white mug clearly matches the source mug’s blue color and shape. Thus there is evidence of change and a possible right-side replacement, but the source mug’s correspondence and movement are not established.
